1.english_reference: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ בִּ שְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְ דָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ τετάρτῳ ἔτει ἐπὶ Δαρείου τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in anno quarto Daríi regis ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , [ that ]

1.english_reference: the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל זְכַרְיָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαρίαν ,
traditions.VUL: factum est verbum Dómini ad Zacharíam ,
traditions.KJV: the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah

1.english_reference: in the fourth [ day ] of the ninth month , [ even ] in Chisleu

traditions.WLC: בְּ אַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַ חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ תְּשִׁעִ֖י בְּ כִסְלֵֽו
traditions.LXX: τετράδι τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἐνάτου ὅς ἐστιν Χασελεύ ·
traditions.VUL: in quarta mensis noni , qui est Casleu .
traditions.KJV: in the fourth [ day ] of the ninth month , [ even ] in Chisleu ;

2.english_reference: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech , and their men

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַח֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל שַׂר אֶ֕צֶר וְ רֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽ אֲנָשָׁ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν εἰς Βαιθὴλ Σαράσαρ καὶ Ἀρβεσεὲρ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Et misérunt ad domum Dei Sárasar , et Rogómmelech , et viri , qui erant cum eo ,
traditions.KJV: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech , and their men ,

traditions.WLC: ו לְ חַלּ֖וֹת אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐξιλάσασθαι τὸν κύριον ,
traditions.VUL: ad deprecándam fáciem Dómini :
traditions.KJV: to pray before the LORD ,

3.english_reference: to speak unto the priests which [ were ] in the house of the LORD of hosts , and to the prophets , saying

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֗ר אֶל הַ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְ בֵית יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ אֶל הַ נְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: λέγων πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς τοὺς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου Παντοκράτορος καὶ πρὸς τοὺς προφήτας , λέγων
traditions.VUL: ut dícerent sacerdótibus domus Dómini exercítuum , et prophétis , loquéntes :
traditions.KJV: [ And ] to speak unto the priests which [ were ] in the house of the LORD of hosts , and to the prophets , saying ,

3.english_reference: Should I weep in the fifth month , separating myself , as I have done these so many years ?

traditions.WLC: הַֽ אֶבְכֶּה֙ בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ חֲמִשִׁ֔י הִנָּזֵ֕ר כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּ מֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים
traditions.LXX: Εἰσελήλυθεν ὧδε ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ τὸ ἁγίασμα , καθότι ἐποίησεν ἤδη ἱκανὰ ἔτη .
traditions.VUL: Numquid flendum est mihi in quinto mense , vel sanctificáre me débeo , sicut iam feci multis annis ?
traditions.KJV: Should I weep in the fifth month , separating myself , as I have done these so many years ?

4.english_reference: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֛י דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini exercítuum ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me , saying ,

5.english_reference: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying

traditions.WLC: אֱמֹר֙ אֶל כָּל עַ֣ם הָ אָ֔רֶץ וְ אֶל הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: Εἰπὸν πρὸς ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς λέγων
traditions.VUL: Lóquere ad omnem pópulum terræ , et ad sacerdótes , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying ,

5.english_reference: When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh [ month ] , even those seventy years

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְ סָפ֜וֹד בַּ חֲמִישִׁ֣י וּ בַ שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ זֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Ἐὰν νηστεύσητε ἢ κόψησθε ἐν ταῖς πέμπταις ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑβδόμαις , καὶ ἰδοὺ ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη
traditions.VUL: Cum ieiunarétis , et plangerétis in quinto et séptimo per hos septuagínta annos ,
traditions.KJV: When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh [ month ] , even those seventy years ,

5.english_reference: did ye at all fast unto me , [ even ] to me ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ צ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖ נִי אָֽנִי
traditions.LXX: μὴ νηστίαν νενηστεύκατέ μοι ?
traditions.VUL: numquid ieiúnium ieiunástis mihi ?
traditions.KJV: did ye at all fast unto me , [ even ] to me ?

6.english_reference: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְ כִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν φάγητε ἢ πίητε ,
traditions.VUL: Et cum comedístis et bibístis ,
traditions.KJV: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink ,

6.english_reference: did not ye eat [ for yourselves ] , and drink [ for yourselves ] ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָ אֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְ אַתֶּ֖ם הַ שֹּׁתִֽים
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ὑμεῖς ἔσθετε καὶ πίνετε ?
traditions.VUL: numquid non vobis comedístis , et vobismetípsis bibístis ?
traditions.KJV: did not ye eat [ for yourselves ] , and drink [ for yourselves ] ?

7.english_reference: [ Should ye ] not [ hear ] the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֣וֹא אֶת הַ דְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ בְּ יַד֙ הַ נְּבִיאִ֣ים הָ רִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: οὐχ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι εἰσὶν οὓς ἐλάλησεν Κύριος ἐν χερσὶν τῶν προφητῶν τῶν ἔμπροσθεν ,
traditions.VUL: Numquid non sunt verba , quæ locútus est Dóminus in manu prophetárum priórum ,
traditions.KJV: [ Should ye ] not [ hear ] the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets ,

7.english_reference: when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when [ men ] inhabited the south and the plain ?

traditions.WLC: בִּ הְי֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּ שְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְ עָרֶ֖י הָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑י הָ וְ הַ נֶּ֥גֶב וְ הַ שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב
traditions.LXX: ὅτε ἦν Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατοικουμένη καὶ εὐθηνοῦσα , καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς κυκλόθεν , καὶ ἡ ὀρεινὴ καὶ ἡ πεδινὴ κατῳκεῖτο ?
traditions.VUL: cum adhuc Ierúsalem habitarétur ut esset opulénta , ipsa et urbes in circúitu eius , et ad austrum , et in campéstribus habitarétur ?
traditions.KJV: when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when [ men ] inhabited the south and the plain ?

8.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah , saying

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ζαχαρίαν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad Zacharíam , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah , saying ,

9.english_reference: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , saying

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
traditions.VUL: Hæc ait Dóminus exercítuum , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , saying ,

9.english_reference: Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother

traditions.WLC: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ שְׁפֹ֔טוּ וְ חֶ֣סֶד וְ רַֽחֲמִ֔ים עֲשׂ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת אָחִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: Κρίμα δίκαιον κρίνατε , καὶ ἔλεος καὶ οἰκτειρμὸν ποιεῖτε ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Iudícium verum iudicáte , et misericórdiam , et miseratiónes fácite , unusquísque cum fratre suo .
traditions.KJV: Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :

10.english_reference: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor

traditions.WLC: וְ אַלְמָנָ֧ה וְ יָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְ עָנִ֖י אַֽל תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ χήran καὶ ὀρφανὸν καὶ προσήλυτον καὶ πένητα μὴ καταδυναστεύετε ,
traditions.VUL: Et víduam , et pupíllum , et ádvenam , et páuperem nolíte calumniári :
traditions.KJV: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor ;

10.english_reference: and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart

traditions.WLC: וְ רָעַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔י ו אַֽל תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ בִּ לְבַבְ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κακίαν ἕκαστος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ μὴ μνησικακείτω ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: et malum vir fratri suo non cógitet in corde suo .
traditions.KJV: and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְ הַקְשִׁ֔יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠπείθησαν τοῦ προσέχειν ,
traditions.VUL: Et noluérunt atténdere ,
traditions.KJV: But they refused to hearken ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנ֥וּ כָתֵ֖ף סֹרָ֑רֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν νῶτον παραφρονοῦντα ,
traditions.VUL: et avertérunt scápulam recedéntem ,
traditions.KJV: and pulled away the shoulder ,

11.english_reference: and stopped their ears, that they should not hear

traditions.WLC: וְ אָזְנֵי הֶ֖ם הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ מִ שְּׁמֽוֹעַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν ἐβάρυναν τοῦ μὴ εἰσακούειν ,
traditions.VUL: et aures suas aggravavérunt ne audírent .
traditions.KJV: and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .

12.english_reference: Yea , they made their hearts [ as ] an adamant stone ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לִבָּ֞ ם שָׂ֣מוּ שָׁמִ֗יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτῶν ἔταξαν ἀπειθῆ
traditions.VUL: Et cor suum posuérunt ut adamántem ,
traditions.KJV: Yea , they made their hearts [ as ] an adamant stone ,

12.english_reference: lest they should hear the law ,

traditions.WLC: מִ֠ שְּׁמוֹעַ אֶת הַ תּוֹרָ֤ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ εἰσακούειν τοῦ νόμου μου
traditions.VUL: ne audírent legem ,
traditions.KJV: lest they should hear the law ,

12.english_reference: and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בְּ רוּח֔ וֹ בְּ יַ֖ד הַ נְּבִיאִ֣ים הָ רִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐξαπέστειλεν Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ ἐν πνεύματι αὐτοῦ ἐν χερσὶν τῶν προφητῶν τῶν ἔμπροσθεν ·
traditions.VUL: et verba quæ misit Dóminus exercítuum in spíritu suo per manum prophetárum priórum :
traditions.KJV: and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets :

12.english_reference: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֔וֹל מֵ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὀργὴ μεγάλη παρὰ Κυρίου Παντοκράτορος .
traditions.VUL: et facta est indignátio magna a Dómino exercítuum .
traditions.KJV: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts .

13.english_reference: Therefore it is come to pass, [ that ] as he cried, and they would not hear

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י כַ אֲשֶׁר קָרָ֖א וְ לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν ,
traditions.VUL: Et factum est sicut locútus est , et non audiérunt :
traditions.KJV: Therefore it is come to pass , [ that ] as he cried , and they would not hear ;

13.english_reference: so they cried, and I would not hear

traditions.WLC: כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע
traditions.LXX: οὕτως κεκράξονται καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσακούσω ,
traditions.VUL: sic clamábunt , et non exáudiam ,
traditions.KJV: so they cried , and I would not hear ,

traditions.WLC: אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ .
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus exercítuum .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD of hosts :

14.english_reference: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗ ם עַ֤ל כָּל הַ גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יְדָע֔וּ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκβαλῶ αὐτοὺς εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἃ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ,
traditions.VUL: Et dispérsi eos per ómnia regna , quæ nésciunt :
traditions.KJV: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not .

14.english_reference: Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵי הֶ֔ם מֵֽ עֹבֵ֖ר וּ מִ שָּׁ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ γῆ ἀφανισθήσεται κατόπισθεν αὐτῶν ἐκ διοδεύοντος καὶ ἐξ ἀναστρέφοντος ·
traditions.VUL: et terra desoláta est ab eis , eo quod non esset tránsiens et revértens :
traditions.KJV: Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned :

14.english_reference: for they laid the pleasant land desolate

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶֽרֶץ חֶמְדָּ֖ה לְ שַׁמָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔταξαν γῆν ἐκλεκτὴν εἰς ἀφανισμόν .
traditions.VUL: et posuérunt terram desiderábilem in desértum .
traditions.KJV: for they laid the pleasant land desolate .
